title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 35 Tulip Avenue in Floral Park, New York, as the Lieutenant Michael R. Davidson Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 35 Tulip Avenue in Floral Park, New York, as the "Lieutenant Michael R. Davidson Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office in Floral Park, New York, after Lieutenant Michael R. Davidson.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 35 Tulip Avenue in Floral Park, New York, as the "Lieutenant Michael R. Davidson Post Office Building." It is an honorary naming and does not change how the post office operates or the services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 3, 2020.
